selectedText: The Next Day Window analysis included 96 consecutive-day pairs with a mean interval of 29.6 hours. Daily maximum BI ranged from 0 to 770, and changes ranged from a loss of 376 to a gain of 464 (mean = $-$10.5 $\pm$ 111.6). Maximum gusts within these intervals ranged from 2.0 to 12.8~m/s (mean = 4.5 $\pm$ 1.8~m/s), and cumulative sun-exposed BI ranged from 0 to 1,122 (mean = 139.8 $\pm$ 206.9).
